name: InReality
tagline: Capture photos and videos, prove they are real
maker_comment_excerpt: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I'm Jeppe, founder of InReality. I spent 7 years researching technologies to fight misinformation and distinguish fake content from real content. Essentially, I was trying to use AI to detect what's fake. But I kept running into the same problem: AI was getting better at creating fake content faster than we could get better at detecting it. This led me to a realization: Instead of trying to prove what's fake, why not make it possible to prove what's real? That's why we built
